    P

    PassAPI - Class in com.atomictempest.pass.api
    The battle pass, for other plugins: give XP for what players do in your plugin, read their tier, and hear when they reach one.
    PassAPI.Backend - Interface in com.atomictempest.pass.api
    The Pass plugin's side of this API.
    PassAPI.TierListener - Interface in com.atomictempest.pass.api
    Called when a player reaches a tier (once per tier, in order).
    PassAPI.XpListener - Interface in com.atomictempest.pass.api
    Called after a player got XP, with how much and their XP this season afterwards.
